Demon ducks, or mihirungs, are some of the strangest and most mysterious birds to ever live. Even though they coexisted with humans for thousands of years, we have very little information about hot they acted, what they ate, and what all their strange features for for. But as scientists continue to dig out and analyze fossils, we're getting an ever clearer picture. This is the mysterious world of the demon duck.
